description: This file defines macros and includes necessary for implementing a custom logging mechanism with easylogging++, enabling multiple log files within a single thread by using custom logger IDs. It manages macro definitions, conditional compilation, and includes external dependencies for logging.

methods.name: LOG
methods.description: Macro for logging at a specified level using the custom logger ID.

methods.name: LOG_IF
methods.description: Macro for conditional logging at a specified level with the custom logger ID.
